% PAGE 1: FOUNDATIONS & ENSEMBLES

\textbf{Fundamental Assumption}: In equilibrium, all accessible microstates
equally probable. 
\[
P(\text{microstate})=\frac{1}{\Omega}
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Thermodynamic Relations}

\textbf{First Law}: $dU=\delta Q-\delta W=TdS-PdV+\mu dN$

\textbf{Second Law}: $dS=\delta Q_{\text{rev}}/T$ for reversible
process.

\textbf{Fundamental Relation (Open System)}: 
\[
\boxed{dU=TdS-PdV+\sum_{i}\mu_{i}dN_{i}}\quad\text{[J]}
\]

\textbf{Thermodynamic Potentials}: 
\begin{align}
F & =U-TS\quad dF=-SdT-PdV+\mu dN\\
H & =U+PV\quad dH=TdS+VdP+\mu dN\\
G & =H-TS=\mu N\quad dG=-SdT+VdP+\mu dN\\
\Phi & =U-TS-\mu N=-PV\quad d\Phi=-SdT-PdV-Nd\mu
\end{align}

\textbf{Maxwell Relations}: 
\[
\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_{T}=\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial T}\right)_{V},\quad\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial P}\right)_{T}=-\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_{P}
\]
\[
\left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial V}\right)_{S}=-\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial S}\right)_{V},\quad\left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial P}\right)_{S}=\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial S}\right)_{P}
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Microcanonical Ensemble ($E,V,N$)}

\textbf{Setup}: Isolated system, fixed $(U,V,N)$.

\textbf{Multiplicity}: $\Omega(E,V,N)$ --- number of accessible
microstates.

\textbf{Entropy}: $\boxed{S=k_{B}\ln\Omega(U,V,N)}\quad\text{[J/K]}$

\textbf{Temperature}: ${\displaystyle \frac{1}{T}=\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial U}\right)_{V,N}}$

\textbf{Pressure}: ${\displaystyle P=T\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial V}\right)_{U}}$

\textbf{Chemical Potential}: ${\displaystyle \mu=T\left(\frac{\partial S}{\partial N}\right)_{U}}$

\subsection{Example: Paramagnet ($N$ spins in field $B$)}

\textbf{Energy}: $U=-M\mu B$ where $M=N_{\uparrow}-N_{\downarrow}$,
$N=N_{\uparrow}+N_{\downarrow}$

\textbf{Multiplicity}: $\Omega(N,M)=\binom{N}{(N+M)/2}$

\textbf{Entropy (Gibbs)}: 
\[
S=Nk_{B}\left[\ln2-\frac{1}{2}\ln(1-m^{2})-\frac{m}{2}\ln\left(\frac{1+m}{1-m}\right)\right]
\]
where $m=M/N\in[-1,1]$.

\textbf{Temperature relation}: 
\[
\boxed{\frac{2\mu B}{k_{B}T}=\ln\left(\frac{1+m}{1-m}\right)}\Rightarrow m=\tanh\left(\frac{\mu B}{k_{B}T}\right)
\]

\textbf{Energy}: $U=-N\mu B\tanh(\mu B/k_{B}T)$\\

\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Canonical Ensemble ($T,V,N$)}

\textbf{Setup}: System in thermal contact with heat bath at temperature
$T$. Fixed $(T,V,N)$.

\textbf{Partition Function}: 
\[
\boxed{Z_{N}=\sum_{i}g_{i}e^{-\beta E_{i}}}\quad\text{[dimensionless]}
\]
For $N$ indistinguishable particles: $Z_{N}=\frac{1}{N!}(Z_{1})^{N}$

\textbf{Probability Distribution (Gibbs Factor)}: 
\[
\boxed{P_{i}=\frac{1}{Z_{N}}e^{-\beta E_{i}}}\quad\text{[dimensionless]}
\]

\textbf{Helmholtz Free Energy}: 
\[
\boxed{F=-k_{B}T\ln Z_{N}}\quad\text{[J]}
\]

\textbf{Thermodynamic Quantities}: 
\begin{align}
U & =\langle E\rangle=-\frac{\partial\ln Z_{N}}{\partial\beta}\quad\text{[J]}\\
S & =k_{B}(\beta\langle E\rangle+\ln Z_{N})\quad\text{[J/K]}\\
C_{V} & =\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial T}\right)_{V}=k_{B}\beta^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}\ln Z_{N}}{\partial\beta^{2}}\quad\text{[J/K]}\\
P & =k_{B}T\left(\frac{\partial\ln Z_{N}}{\partial V}\right)_{T}\quad\text{[Pa]}
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Grand Canonical Ensemble ($T,V,\mu$)}

\textbf{Setup}: Open system, fixed $(T,V,\mu)$. Exchange energy and
particles.

\textbf{Grand Partition Function}: 
\[
\boxed{\mathcal{Z}=\sum^{\infty}_{N=0}e^{\beta\mu N}Z_{N}=\sum_{\text{all states}}e^{\beta(\mu N-E)}}
\]

\textbf{Grand Potential (Landau Free Energy)}: 
\[
\boxed{\Phi=-k_{B}T\ln\mathcal{Z}=-PV}\quad\text{[J]}
\]

\textbf{Thermodynamic Relations}: 
\begin{align}
\langle N\rangle & =-\left(\frac{\partial\Phi}{\partial\mu}\right)_{T,V}=k_{B}T\left(\frac{\partial\ln\mathcal{Z}}{\partial\mu}\right)_{T,V}\\
\langle U\rangle & =-\left(\frac{\partial\ln\mathcal{Z}}{\partial\beta}\right)_{\mu,V}\\
P & =-\left(\frac{\partial\Phi}{\partial V}\right)_{T,\mu}=\frac{k_{B}T\ln\mathcal{Z}}{V}
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Classical vs. Quantum}

\textbf{Classical Partition Function}: 
\[
Z_{\text{cl}}=\frac{1}{N!h^{3N}}\int e^{-\beta H(p,q)}d^{3N}p\,d^{3N}q
\]

\textbf{Quantum}: Replace with sum over eigenstates with proper symmetrization.

% PAGE 2: APPLICATIONS & QUANTUM STATISTICS

\section{Ideal Classical Gas}

\textbf{Hamiltonian}: $H=\sum_{i}\frac{p^{2}_{i}}{2m}$

\textbf{Partition Function}: 
\[
Z=\frac{V^{N}}{N!\lambda^{3N}},\quad\lambda=\sqrt{\frac{2\pi\hbar^{2}}{mk_{B}T}}
\]
(thermal de Broglie wavelength) \rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} \textbf{Thermodynamics}:
\begin{align}
U & =\frac{3}{2}Nk_{B}T\quad\text{[J]}\\
C_{V} & =\frac{3}{2}Nk_{B}\quad\text{[J/K]}\\
PV & =Nk_{B}T\quad\text{[J]}\\
S & =Nk_{B}\left[\frac{5}{2}+\ln\left(\frac{V}{N\lambda^{3}}\right)\right]\quad\text{[J/K]}
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\subsection{Einstein Solid}

$N$ distinguishable oscillators, each with frequency $\omega$.

\textbf{Single oscillator}: $Z_{1}=\frac{e^{-\beta\hbar\omega/2}}{1-e^{-\beta\hbar\omega}}$

\textbf{N oscillators}: $Z=Z^{N}_{1}$

\textbf{Energy}: 
\[
U=N\hbar\omega\left(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{e^{\beta\hbar\omega}-1}\right)
\]

\textbf{Heat capacity}: 
\[
C_{V}=Nk_{B}\left(\frac{\beta\hbar\omega}{e^{\beta\hbar\omega}-1}\right)^{2}e^{\beta\hbar\omega}
\]
Limits: $T\to0$: $C_{V}\propto e^{-\hbar\omega/k_{B}T}$ (Debye);
$T\to\infty$: $C_{V}\to Nk_{B}$ (Dulong-Petit). \\
 \rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Density of States \& Phase Space}

\textbf{Phase-Space Counting}: $N(\le p)\sim\frac{V}{(2\pi\hbar)^{d}}p^{d}\Rightarrow N(\le p)\propto p^{d}$

\textbf{Massless Dispersion} ($E=pc$): 
\begin{align}
N(\le E) & \propto E^{d},\quad g(E)\propto E^{d-1}
\end{align}

\textbf{Massive Dispersion} ($E=p^{2}/2m$): 
\begin{align}
N(\le E) & \propto E^{d/2},\quad g(E)\propto E^{d/2-1}
\end{align}

\textbf{Summary} (3D): \\

\section{Fermi-Dirac \& Bose-Einstein Statistics}

\textbf{Occupation number}: 
\[
\boxed{\langle n_{\epsilon}\rangle=\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}+\xi}}\quad\text{[dimensionless, }0\leq n\leq1\text{]}
\]
where $\xi=+1$ (Fermi), $\xi=-1$ (Bose).

\textbf{Fermi-Dirac}: ${\displaystyle f_{F}(\epsilon)=\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}+1}}$
(antisymmetric wave functions, Pauli exclusion)

\textbf{Bose-Einstein}: ${\displaystyle f_{B}(\epsilon)=\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}-1}}$
(symmetric, $\mu<\epsilon_{0}$) \rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\subsection{Density of States}

For massive particles in $d$ dimensions: 
\[
g(\epsilon)\propto\epsilon^{d/2-1},\quad N(\le\epsilon)=\int^{\epsilon}_{0}g(\epsilon')\,d\epsilon'\propto\epsilon^{d/2}
\]

For photons (massless, $d=3$): $g(\omega)\propto\omega^{2}$

\subsection{Degenerate Fermi Gas ($T\to0$)}

All states filled up to Fermi energy: $\mu(T=0)=\epsilon_{F}$

\textbf{Fermi Energy}: 
\[
\boxed{\epsilon_{F}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{2m}(3\pi^{2}n)^{2/3}}\quad\text{[J]}
\]

\textbf{Fermi Temperature}: $T_{F}=\epsilon_{F}/k_{B}$

\textbf{Sommerfeld Expansion} (Heat Capacity): 
\[
\boxed{C_{V}\approx\frac{\pi^{2}}{3}Nk_{B}\frac{T}{T_{F}}}\quad(T\ll T_{F})
\]

\textbf{Thermal Corrections}: 
\begin{align}
\mu(T) & \approx\epsilon_{F}\left[1-\frac{\pi^{2}}{12}\left(\frac{T}{T_{F}}\right)^{2}\right]\\
U(T) & \approx\frac{3}{5}N\epsilon_{F}\left[1+\frac{5\pi^{2}}{12}\left(\frac{T}{T_{F}}\right)^{2}\right]
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Blackbody Radiation}

\textbf{Photon gas}: bosons with $\mu=0$ (no constraint on photon
number).

\textbf{Energy density}: 
\[
u(\omega,T)=\frac{\hbar\omega^{3}}{\pi^{2}c^{3}}\frac{1}{e^{\beta\hbar\omega}-1}\quad\text{[J/Hz]}
\]

\textbf{Stefan-Boltzmann Law}: 
\[
U=\frac{\pi^{2}k^{4}_{B}T^{4}V}{15\hbar^{3}c^{3}}\quad\text{[J]},\quad P=\frac{U}{3V}\quad\text{[Pa]},\quad C_{V}=\frac{4\sigma VT^{3}}{c}\quad\text{[J/K]}
\]

\textbf{Wien displacement law}: $\lambda_{\max}T=2.898\times10^{-3}$
m·K \rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Bose-Einstein Condensation}

Below critical temperature $T_{c}$: 
\[
\boxed{k_{B}T_{c}=\frac{2\pi\hbar^{2}}{m}\left(\frac{n}{g\zeta(3/2)}\right)^{2/3}}\quad\text{[K]}
\]
where $\zeta(3/2)\approx2.612$, $g=2s+1$ is degeneracy.

\textbf{Condensate Fraction}: 
\[
\boxed{\frac{N_{0}}{N}=1-\left(\frac{T}{T_{c}}\right)^{3/2}}\quad(T<T_{c})
\]

\textbf{Energy}: $U=\frac{3}{5}N_{\text{exc}}k_{B}T$, where $N_{\text{exc}}=N(T/T_{c})^{3/2}$

\section{Debye Model}

Phonon spectrum cutoff at $\omega_{D}$ (Debye frequency).

\textbf{Debye temperature}: $\Theta_{D}=\hbar\omega_{D}/k_{B}$

\textbf{Heat capacity}: 
\[
C_{V}=12\pi^{4}Nk_{B}\left(\frac{T}{\Theta_{D}}\right)^{3}\quad(T\ll\Theta_{D})
\]
\[
C_{V}\to3Nk_{B}\quad(T\gg\Theta_{D})\text{ [Dulong-Petit]}
\]

% PAGE 3: INTERACTING SYSTEMS
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.5pt} 

\section{Ising Model (Mean Field)}

\textbf{Hamiltonian}: 
\[
H=-J\sum_{\langle i,j\rangle}s_{i}s_{j}-h\sum_{i}s_{i}
\]
($J$ = coupling, $h$ = external field, $s_{i}=\pm1$)

\textbf{Self-Consistency Equation}: 
\[
\boxed{m=\tanh(\beta(zJm+h))}\quad\text{[\ensuremath{m} dimensionless]}
\]
where $z$ = coordination number, $m=\langle s\rangle$.

\textbf{Critical Temperature}: 
\[
\boxed{k_{B}T_{c}=zJ}\quad\text{[K]}
\]

\textbf{Susceptibility}: 
\[
\chi\propto(T-T_{c})^{-1}\quad\text{(critical exponent }\gamma=1\text{)}
\]

\textbf{Order Parameter} (near $T_{c}$): 
\[
m\propto(T_{c}-T)^{1/2}\quad(T<T_{c},\text{ exponent }\beta=1/2)
\]

% PAGE 4: MATHEMATICAL REFERENCE & FORMULAS
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.5pt} 

\section{Useful Mathematical Identities}

\textbf{Gaussian integral}: $\int^{\infty}_{-\infty}e^{-\alpha x^{2}}\,dx=\sqrt{\pi/\alpha}$

\textbf{Stirling}: $\ln N!\approx N\ln N-N+\frac{1}{2}\ln(2\pi N)$

\textbf{Poisson summation}: $\sum_{n}e^{-\beta E_{n}}\approx\int g(E)e^{-\beta E}\,dE$
(thermodynamic limit)

\textbf{Geometric series}: $\sum^{\infty}_{n=0}x^{n}=1/(1-x)$ ($|x|<1$)
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Thermodynamic Identities}

\[
\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_{S}=T\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial S}\right)_{V}-P
\]

\[
\left(\frac{\partial U}{\partial V}\right)_{T}=T\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial T}\right)_{V}-P
\]

\[
\left(\frac{\partial H}{\partial P}\right)_{S}=T\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial S}\right)_{P}+V
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Asymptotic Behaviors}

\[
\tanh(x)\approx\begin{cases}
x & x\ll1\\
1 & x\gg1
\end{cases}
\]

\[
e^{-\beta E}\approx\begin{cases}
1-\beta E & \beta E\ll1\\
0 & \beta E\gg1
\end{cases}
\]

\[
\ln(1+x)\approx x-x^{2}/2+\cdots
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Constants \& Conversions}

\begin{align}
k_{B} & =1.381\times10^{-23}\text{ J/K}=8.617\times10^{-5}\text{ eV/K}\\
\hbar & =1.055\times10^{-34}\text{ J·s}\\
k_{B}T\text{(eV)} & =0.0862\times T(\text{K})\quad\text{at }300\text{ K: }k_{B}T\approx0.026\text{ eV}
\end{align}


\section{Quick Reference: Partition Functions}

\begin{align}
\text{2-level system} & :Z=e^{-\beta E_{1}}+e^{-\beta E_{2}}\\
\text{Harmonic osc.} & :Z=\frac{e^{-\beta\hbar\omega/2}}{1-e^{-\beta\hbar\omega}}\\
\text{Ideal gas} & :Z=\frac{V^{N}}{N!\lambda^{3N}}\\
\text{Paramagnet} & :Z=(2\cosh(\beta\mu B))^{N}\\
\text{Photon gas} & :\ln\mathcal{Z}=-\sum_{k}\ln(1-e^{-\beta\hbar\omega_{k}})
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Order Parameters \& Susceptibilities}

\textbf{Magnetic susceptibility}: 
\[
\chi=\left(\frac{\partial m}{\partial h}\right)_{T}=k^{-1}_{B}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial h^{2}}\right)
\]

\textbf{Compressibility}: 
\[
\kappa_{T}=-\frac{1}{V}\left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial P}\right)_{T}=\frac{1}{Vk_{B}T}\langle(\Delta N)^{2}\rangle/\langle N\rangle^{2}
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Fluctuations}

\[
\langle(\Delta E)^{2}\rangle=k_{B}T^{2}C_{V}\quad\text{[J}^{2}\text{]}
\]
\[
\langle(\Delta N)^{2}\rangle=k_{B}T\kappa_{T}\langle N\rangle^{2}/V\quad\text{[dimensionless]}
\]
\[
\text{Relative}:\frac{\Delta E}{U}\sim\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}},\quad\frac{\Delta N}{N}\sim\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}
\]
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt} 

\section{Mathematical Functions}

\textbf{Polylogarithm}: 
\[
\text{Li}_{n}(z)=\sum^{\infty}_{k=1}\frac{z^{k}}{k^{n}}=\frac{1}{\Gamma(n)}\int^{\infty}_{0}\frac{x^{n-1}}{z^{-1}e^{x}-1}dx
\]

\textbf{Riemann Zeta}: $\zeta(n)=\text{Li}_{n}(1)$ 
\begin{align}
\zeta(3/2) & \approx2.612\\
\zeta(2) & =\pi^{2}/6\approx1.645\\
\zeta(3) & \approx1.202
\end{align}
\rule{1\columnwidth}{0.4pt}
